# ./... behaves like other go tools: packages with no buildable files are
# skipped silently and the rest are processed.

loopvec -split ./...
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp sub/ops_simd.go sub/ops_simd.go.want
! exists ops_simd.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- magefile.go --
//go:build mage

package main

func Build() {}
-- sub/ops.go --
package sub

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- sub/ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package sub

import "simd"

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(b[_i:])
		_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/sub/ops.go
